SPIRITS-RAMMED_EARTH.title: Rammed Earth
SPIRITS-RAMMED_EARTH.description: At the start of each combat, gain 3 [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold].
SPIRITS-STONE_PACT.title: Stone Pact
SPIRITS-STONE_PACT.description: At the end of your turn, if you have no [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold], gain 2.
SPIRITS-COLD_ASH.title: Cold Ash
SPIRITS-COLD_ASH.description: Whenever your HP drops below 25%, gain [gold]Flash[/gold] 2.
SPIRITS-SHADOW_IN_MIRROR.title: Shadow in Mirror
SPIRITS-SHADOW_IN_MIRROR.description: Whenever a card is Consumed, gain 5 [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIRITS-OSCILLATION_CIRCUIT.title: Oscillation Circuit
SPIRITS-OSCILLATION_CIRCUIT.description: After [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] trigger, gain [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] equal to half the trigger value.
SPIRITS-FORMLESS_TWIN_BLADES.title: Formless Twin Blades
SPIRITS-FORMLESS_TWIN_BLADES.description: Whenever [gold]Flash[/gold] triggers, deal 20 damage to all enemies.
SPIRITS-THREE_BOWLS.title: Three Bowls
SPIRITS-THREE_BOWLS.description: When you enter an Elite room, heal half your missing HP, rounded down.
SPIRITS-CIVIL_ENGINEERING.title: Civil Engineering
SPIRITS-CIVIL_ENGINEERING.description: At the start of each turn, you and all enemies gain 4 Plated Armor.
SPIRITS-JIUTAI.title: Jiutai
SPIRITS-JIUTAI.description: At the start of each combat, gain 4 [gold]Stone Remnants[/gold], 2 [gold]Flash[/gold], and 8 [gold]Static Remnants[/gold]. Replaces your starting relic.
SPIRITS-FEEDBACK_CIRCUIT.title: Feedback Circuit
SPIRITS-FEEDBACK_CIRCUIT.description: When you would take damage, lose [gold]Static Remnants[/gold] first.
SPIRITS-EMBER_LANTERN.title: Ember Lantern
SPIRITS-EMBER_LANTERN.description: When [gold]Flash[/gold] triggers, it decreases by 2 instead of 3.
SPIRITS-UNBOUND.title: Unbound
SPIRITS-UNBOUND.description: At the start of each combat, choose and add Boulder Form, Ember Form, or Storm Form to your hand.
